The Studio

Not a salon visit — a standing appointment with yourself.

Via Dolce Salon built its name in Coral Gables on one belief: great hair is never rushed. Every appointment starts with a real consultation and ends with you knowing exactly how to keep the look alive at home.

  • Senior stylists only — no hand-offs, no surprises
  • Honest timelines & honest pricing, up front
  • Premium color lines, gentle on hair

— Good to know

Before you book.

Every service lists its duration and price up front — and if it's not right, we make it right. That's our guarantee.

How much will it cost?

Prices are confirmed at your consultation, before any work begins. Colour is quoted after we see your hair, so the price you approve is the price you pay.

How long will my appointment take?

A cut takes 30–60 minutes; colour and balayage take 90 minutes to 3 hours. Every service lists its duration and time, and your stylist confirms it at booking — no rushing, no surprises.

What if I don't like the result?

If it's not right, we make it right — re-cut, tone or adjust, no charge. That's our guarantee.

What to expect at your first visit

A real consultation first: your stylist looks at your hair, asks how you live with it, and agrees the cut or colour with you before touching a scissor. You leave knowing exactly how to keep the look alive at home.

10% off your first visit

New clients save 10% on their first appointment — mention this page when you book.
